commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Romain Lissorgue shows the yellow card to Isak Jansson (Nice) for a heavy challenge.
89' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Morgan Sanson (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
85' Bamo Meite has picked up an injury and is replaced by Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient).
82' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) will replace Theo Le Bris.
79' Olivier Pantaloni decides to make a substitution. Sambou Soumano will be replaced by Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
78' A pass from Noah Cadiou (Lorient) is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf and the move breaks down.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohamed-Ali Cho walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
75' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lorient.
71' Kevin (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball.
69' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

69' Morgan Sanson (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
68' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Salis Abdul Samed and he is replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
67' Isak Jansson (Nice) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
65' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Pablo Pagis goes off the pitch and Dermane Karim (Lorient) comes on.
63' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to make a change. Noah Cadiou (Lorient) replaces Jean-Victor Makengo.

63' Yvon Mvogo pulls off a brilliant save! Kevin (Nice) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
61' Franck Haise is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kojo Peprah (Nice) suffers an injury and Ali Abdi comes on.
60' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isak Jansson (Nice) replacing Tiago Gouveia.
59' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Sofiane Diop is replaced by Kevin (Nice).
56' A yellow card for a tackle by Sofiane Diop (Nice). Romain Lissorgue doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
53' 3 - 1 Sambou Soumano (Lorient) scores from the corner kick. The ball slipped through the box to Sambou Soumano (Lorient) and he slotted it past the goalkeeper.
53' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

53' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Yehvann Diouf shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lorient will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Lorient work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
51' A cross into the box from Montassar Talbi (Lorient) is cleared. Lorient force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Yehvann Diouf displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Theo Le Bris (Lorient) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle as Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 2 - 1 It’s a GOAL! Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is the first to get on the end of a lofted pass and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
45+2' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+1' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Yvon Mvogo shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Tom Louchet (Nice) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
43' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

43' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
41' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
40' Kojo Peprah (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Romain Lissorgue no option but to blow his whistle.
40' Nice enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' Antoine Mendy (Nice) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
35' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) steps up to send the ball in.

34' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
31' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Laurent Abergel (Lorient) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Yehvann Diouf. He makes it 1:1.
29' The players claim that Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
27' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) receives a yellow card for infringement.
26' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
25' The ball is cleared after Terem Moffi (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Lorient! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Romain Lissorgue and both teams have no complaints.
22' There's a break in play and referee Romain Lissorgue must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lorient using VAR. This could be interesting!
20' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

18' A cross from Tom Louchet (Nice) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

17' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
14' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) commits a foul after dangerous play.

12' 0 - 1 Arthur Avom (Lorient) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
11' A lofted cross from Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' The ball rebounds out to Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
7' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

5' Ambitious effort from Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
2' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Nice will take the kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue will officiate today.
